title: Felix and the Oath
author: Silas Joubert
blurb: Zephyrine Whitlock, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
